summary: Dispatches a command by selector 19 through the object referenced by global dword_7CD8C0, then compares the returned object's name against this. Returns 0 regardless of the result.

operations.description: Indirect __thiscall through the vtable of dword_7CD8C0 at offset 28, requesting the object for selector 19; store the returned pointer.
Guard on the returned pointer being non-null before the name comparison.
Call ObjectNameComparison with the dispatched object and this as arguments.

unresolved: Identity of the dispatcher object behind dword_7CD8C0 and the meaning of selector 19.
Semantics of ObjectNameComparison and why its result is discarded.
